purpose: Teach: レクチャー/手放し/首位/バスケット/お宝/石垣/掘っ/オーロラ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼に、車のレクチャー、本気で、受けてきたよ、メイちゃん、本当に、勉強になったわ、絶対、感謝してる。
lines.en: Aoi, he gave me a serious lesson about cars, and I really learned so much. I'm genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate opening. Genuine gratitude without overstatement. Steady pace, voice lifting slightly on the learning. Easy, sincere.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵の店、本当に、手放しで、お客様、褒めてくださってるのよ、メイちゃん、本気で、嬉しいわよ、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. Your customers really praise the shop so openly — it honestly makes me happy for you.
lines.style: Bright but grounded. Not performing cheerfulness, just genuine warmth. Small laugh underneath. Sincere and comfortable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵で、最近、業界の首位、本気で、目指したいって、葵の決意、本当に、応援してるよ、絶対、メイちゃん、本気で。
lines.en: I really admire how you've been aiming to be the best in the industry lately. I'm genuinely cheering you on.
lines.style: Sincere and steady. Conviction in the words without pushing. Soft intensity — this matters to her. No performance, just real support.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お子様、バスケットボール、本気で、頑張ってるって、葵で、お客様、本当に、よく、話されるのよ、絶対、本気で、可愛い。
lines.en: Your customers talk about how hard your kids work at basketball — it's really something they mention often. It's adorable.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Not gushing, but warm. There's affection in noticing the small details. Gentle pace, like she's sharing something she's noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店、本気で、お宝みたいな、雑貨、置いてあるよね、メイちゃん、毎回、本当に、楽しみなのよ、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Your shop always has these little treasures — the curios and goods you pick. I genuinely look forward to it every time.
lines.style: Animated but genuine. Light and enthusiastic without being forced. The joy of discovering something new. Quick, engaged delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 地方の城、本気で、石垣の保存、本当に、見事よね、葵で、いつか、メイちゃんと、行ってみたいわよ、絶対、本気。
lines.en: That old castle in the countryside, the stonework preservation is really remarkable. I'd love to go there with you sometime.
lines.style: Wistful and reaching. A shared dream underneath the words. Gentle, almost tentative — inviting but not demanding. Warmth mixed with quiet hope.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 庭で、彼、本気で、池、掘ったって、葵で、聞いた?本当に、すごいよね、本気で、感心しちゃったよ、絶対、メイちゃん。
lines.en: Did you hear? Your partner actually dug a pond in the garden — seriously, I was so impressed when I found out.
lines.style: Animated admiration. Small pause before the reveal. Genuine astonishment in the delivery. Appreciative, not gossipy. Brightness when sharing the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夜のオーロラ、本気で、見に行きたいよね、メイちゃん、葵で、いつか、一緒に、行きましょうね、絶対、本気で、夢、ね、絶対。
lines.en: Seeing the northern lights together — that's such a dream, isn't it? Let's make that happen someday.
lines.style: Dreamy and tender. Soft, almost reverent tone. Reaches toward shared future. Pace slows slightly at the end. Quiet conviction that it will happen.
